faq_heading: Homes near Semiahmoo Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Semiahmoo Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Semiahmoo Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Semiahmoo Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Semiahmoo Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 574 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,520,000, townhomes $925,000, condos $530,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Semiahmoo Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Semiahmoo Secondary the median was 31 days on the market, closing at 96.4% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 574 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Semiahmoo Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are H T Thrift Elementary (0.1 km south), Newbridge Academy (0.9 km east) and Bayridge Elementary (1.1 km west).

How the Semiahmoo Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Semiahmoo Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Semiahmoo Secondary

15 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Semiahmoo Secondary in a straight line (9 elementary, 3 other, 3 secondary; 5 independent). The closest is H T Thrift Elementary, 0.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is Southridge School, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is St John Paul II Academy (1.7 km); the nearest independent school is Newbridge Academy (0.9 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Jessie Lee Elementary (1.4 km). Other secondary schools close by: St John Paul II Academy (1.7 km south-east), Earl Marriott Secondary (2.1 km east), Elgin Park Secondary (2.8 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is St John Paul II Academy, 1.7 km south-east of Semiahmoo Secondary.
